Class AsiContainerProperties

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.AsiContainerProperties
public class AsiContainerProperties extends Object
Domain entity and I/O manager for the persistent anahata.asi.properties metadata file stored in each ASI container version directory.

This file unambiguously marks a filesystem directory as a genuine Anahata ASI container directory (distinguishing it from non-container directories such as screenshots or temporary scratchpads) and records vital lifecycle attributes including container version, host application ID, and creation timestamp.

anahata
